answer.answer:
Firm_060 is the standout repeat collaborator, appearing as a joint developer or manufacturer in four separate deployed processes with four different sets of partners, more than any other firm in this evidence set. Several other firms show up as co-developers on exactly two records each, always alongside different partner combinations: Firm_061, Firm_082, Firm_168, Firm_033, Firm_115 and Firm_151. All of these are co-occurrence partnerships on shared robot development, not directional dependency or capability-enabling relations.

**Firm_060, the most frequent partner.** Firm_060 is named in a joint development partnership: Firm_168, Firm_060, Firm_008, Firm_009, Firm_064 jointly developed this construction robot [1] (census_RXM6-4), then again in a joint development partnership: Firm_060, Firm_061, Firm_079 jointly developed this construction robot [2] (census_RXM6-7), and again in a joint development partnership: Firm_060, Firm_061 jointly developed this construction robot [3] (census_RXM6-6). Beyond these three co-development codev records, Firm_060 also shows up as a developer on the deployed process behind case census_RXM29-4, described as deployed robotic construction process census_RXM29-4, adopted to address integration, regulation; performs material handling; at technology readiness level 5; developed by Firm_168, Firm_033, Firm_060, Firm_115 [4]. That is four distinct records with four different partner rosters, the broadest co-development footprint in this set.

**Firms with two co-development records.**
- Firm_061 pairs with Firm_060 twice, in census_RXM6-7 and census_RXM6-6, both cited above.
- Firm_082 appears in Firm_082, Firm_072 jointly developed this construction robot [5] (census_RXM8-3) and again in Firm_003, Firm_082 jointly developed this construction robot [6] (census_RXM8-1), with a different partner each time.
- Firm_168 recurs in census_RXM6-4 (above) and in census_RXM29-4's developer list (above).
- Firm_033 recurs in census_RXM29-4's developer list (above) and separately in the codev record for census_RXH5-4, where Firm_027, Firm_028, Firm_033 jointly developed this construction robot [7], matching its profile record which notes it was developed by Firm_027, Firm_028, Firm_033 [8] for a cleaning process at technology readiness level 9.
- Firm_115 recurs in census_RXM29-4 (above) and in census_RXM4-4, where the profile states the process was developed by Firm_115, Firm_121 [9] for 3d printing, concrete work, material handling and shotcrete at technology readiness level 7.
- Firm_151 appears twice on 3D-printing-related shotcrete work: developed by Firm_151, Firm_077 [10] for census_RXM11-4 (technology readiness level 8) and developed by Firm_151, Firm_020 [11] for census_RXM11-6 (technology readiness level 7).

**What to watch.** All other firms in the supplied context, Firm_072, Firm_079, Firm_003, Firm_097, Firm_098, Firm_002, Firm_018, Firm_068, Firm_094, Firm_134, Firm_177, Firm_209, Firm_027, Firm_028, Firm_121, Firm_077, Firm_020, appear on only a single co-development record each in this evidence set, so they should not be read as repeat collaborators based on what is here. The recurrence pattern is purely a co-occurrence signal across manufacturer and developer listings; the context carries no dependsOn or enablesCapability edges that would indicate one firm's participation is a technical precondition for another's.

**Deployed evidence.** The processes in the graph closest to this question, each a real deployment with its record id:
- census_RXM29-4, adopted to address integration, regulation; performs material handling; at technology readiness level 5; developed by Firm_168, Firm_033, Firm_060, Firm_115.
- census_RXM11-4, adopted to address cost, labor, integration; performs 3d printing, assembly, concrete work, shotcrete; at technology readiness level 8; developed by Firm_151, Firm_077.
- census_RXM4-4, adopted to address integration; performs 3d printing, concrete work, material handling, shotcrete; at technology readiness level 7; developed by Firm_115, Firm_121.
- census_RXH5-4, adopted to address labor; performs cleaning; at technology readiness level 9; developed by Firm_027, Firm_028, Firm_033.
- census_RXM11-6, adopted to address cost, integration; performs 3d printing, concrete work, shotcrete, surface treatment; at technology readiness level 7; developed by Firm_151, Firm_020.
